messages.label: drag a span, or move it with the keyboard
messages.note: the view snaps to the week and previews at the target placement

messages.label: propose PlannedWindow (and lane, if it moved)
messages.note: the plan validates the window: end >= start, both inclusive

messages.label: put it back, and say why

cards.title: A proposal, not a change
items: The view that draws the plan never edits it
It reports where something was dropped and redraws from what it gets back
Nothing is persisted until the plan has accepted it

cards.title: A drop that moves nothing
items: Less than half a week travelled produces no proposal at all
An edge clamped against the opposite edge produces no proposal either
Picking something up and putting it down must not rewrite a plan

cards.title: What the plan does not do
items: A reschedule never touches dependencies; dependent work is not dragged along
The plan is allowed to contradict itself, and that is the reader's cue
The event carries the previous window, so a consumer needs no history of its own
